title: Client Outputs
description: Schema defining the output of the data contents

created on.description: The timestamp of when the report was created

model id.description: The id of the model trained

partitions file.description: The file used to partition the data for training

min_fit_clients.description: The minimum number of clients that must contribute to the federated training rounds

min_available_clients.description: The minimum number of clients that must be connected to the server for the federated learning to begin

min_evaluate_clients.description: The minimum number of clients that must participate in a federated evaluation round for the round to be successful

data_partitions_file.description: A path to a file that contains the data partitions - NEED TO RESTRICT THIS VALUE

partitioner_type.description: The type of partitioner to use if a data partition was not provided

partition_id.description: Partition ID used for the current client

client_id.description: Client ID used for the current client

seed.description: The seed used to randomize training/testing

epochs.description: The number of model training epochs. An epoch is one full pass through a training dataset

batch_divisor.description: The divisor to determine the number of batches (num_batches = dataset_size/batch_divisor) -- I can only check this after loading in the dataset, not in the json

n_models.description: The number of models to train. This can be useful if simulating federated learning locally

test_frac.description: The fraction of the data set to set aside for testing

learning_rate.description: Sets the model’s learning rate. This defines how much a model changes at each iteration

weight_decay.description: Sets the model’s weight decay. This is a regularization method that penalizes high weights

optimizer.description: The optimizer is responsible for adjusting model parameters based on the value of the loss function

opacus_secure_mode.description: Turns on differential privacy when set to True

epsilon.description: Determines the amount of privacy added to the data.

delta.description: Measures the chance of a data breach. It defines the probability of the noise not adding sufficient privacy

max_grad_norm.description: Clips the gradients to be under this maximum before adding noise

accuracy_tolerance.description: Error tolerance to declare prediction as correct

output_dir.description: The output path for the generated reports

data_dir.description: the directory to the data files
